name: system_and_discovery
label: System and discovery
description: System distance, parallax and number of stars/planets, and discovery details for planets this paper announces.
system_prompt: Extract planetary-system and discovery details from an astronomy paper, exactly as stated.
intro: For the planetary systems in the structure plan below, extract system details (whole set: sample_label '') and, ONLY for planets this paper itself reports as newly discovered or confirmed, the discovery details (per planet).

parameters.description: number of stars in the system
number of planets in the system

rules: Report the values THIS paper gives for each planet -- its own fit, or the values it adopts and uses (then say in `note` where they come from, e.g. 'adopted from Takeda et al. 2008'). Don't fill in values from other papers that this paper only mentions in passing.
When a value is given in several places (abstract, text, table), use the table value with its uncertainties.
Discovery details belong only to planets this paper announces or confirms as new; leave them out for planets discovered earlier.

A planet with several samples (one per solution, the solution in [brackets] in its sample_label) gets each solution's values on its own sample_label -- never mix values from different solutions on one row.
